races.name: Get Raceday Ready Handicap

runners_data.name: Punchbowl Flyer
runners_data.note: Sole leader but hasn't won on AW and recent form suggests decline from spring efforts
runners_data.spotlight: Was running well at 6f and 7f here in the spring but he's never won on the AW and has seemingly gone off the boil a touch, having run a rare moderate race at Chepstow recently.

runners_data.name: Lessay
runners_data.note: Strong course record but 24 days off and trainer struggling for winners recently
runners_data.spotlight: Three AW wins, the latest over C&D in December; went through a quiet spell since his most recent 7f run here (in January) but fared better back over C&D in May when going close off a reduced mark; bang there.

runners_data.name: Thapa Vc
runners_data.note: Multiple course winner on handy mark but two years since AW success raises questions
runners_data.spotlight: Multiple wins include four over C&D; his losing AW run goes back two years but he's on a handy mark now and showed he can make it pay when close up at Bath (1m) recently after getting checked in his run; blinkers return and Oisin Murphy rides for the first time; can be involved.

runners_data.name: Cooramook
runners_data.note: Often runs well here but draws widest stall which could be advantage in big field finish
runners_data.spotlight: Has often run well on this track, including over this trip, but she often finds others are stronger finishers at 7f and has yet to break her duck; has the widest draw to overcome as well.

runners_data.name: Reputation
runners_data.note: Ageless wonder in great form with recent 7f win, hold-up style suits race shape perfectly
runners_data.spotlight: No sign at all of age wearying him during the winter, having won over C&D in November, and he returned from a break as fresh as paint with a 7f win at Southwell last month; back up 4lb; one of a few to consider.

runners_data.name: Amaysmont
runners_data.note: Course winner with two solid recent 7f efforts, particularly strong finish at Southwell
runners_data.spotlight: Seven AW wins include one over C&D, and his two most recent 7f runs, here in February and at Southwell 11 days ago, were up there with his best efforts over the last year; likely to need extra from a high draw though.

runners_data.name: Good Karma
runners_data.note: Good course record but 45 days off and headgear changes suggest connections seeking improvement
runners_data.spotlight: Things didn't pan out for him when back over 6f here in April (first-time visor; cheekpieces now refitted) but he has a good C&D record, winning once and close up in all three handicaps; has a good run in him.

runners_data.name: Fistral Beach
runners_data.note: Three recent course wins but bled last time which is concerning for stamina
runners_data.spotlight: Three most recent wins have come over C&D, the latest in March; has remained in form, though she bled from the nose when third at Southwell (7f) in April; if showing no ill effects she shouldn't be too far away.

runners_data.name: Happier
runners_data.note: Returns after 168 days but both wins at shorter trips, needs to prove 7f effectiveness
runners_data.spotlight: Both handicap wins at 5f, on Southwell AW and turf; creditable yard debut at Lingfield (6f) in December but wasn't seen again after a lesser effort that month and, having only her second 7f run, others have less to prove.

runners_data.name: Fircombe Hall
runners_data.note: Mostly 6f specialist but stayed on well last time, quick return after 6 days
runners_data.spotlight: C&D win was sole 7f success among eight others over 6f; however, he stayed on well and only just failed to get up over Newcastle's stiff 6f in April so a good run isn't impossible in first 7f run since March 2025.

runners_data.name: South Kensington
runners_data.note: New yard showing good form and horse responding well to tongue tie addition
runners_data.spotlight: Won two of her last three starts for previous yard (7f; AW and turf) once tongue tied; has come to hand for new connections on AW of late, finishing well into second of 13 at Wolverhampton (about 1m) then slowly away but getting to the front quite readily at Southwell (7f) since; now 4lb higher but should have another race in her.

runners_data.name: Rosemary's Rose
runners_data.note: Distance winner moving back to 7f but strong recent AW form gives confidence
runners_data.spotlight: Two 1m wins on AW this spring, in a Lingfield classified event and a Kempton handicap; just respectable efforts in the meantime (slightly hampered at Bath recently) but she had excuses when last tried over 7f and might yet do better at this trip.

races.paceDynamic: Punchbowl Flyer is the sole confirmed front runner and will set the pace from the rail, with Happier the only other forward-going runner likely to sit prominently. The pace will be steady and controlled given the lack of early speed, allowing the large field of hold-up horses to get into contention. With 10 runners employing hold-up tactics including in-form types like Reputation, South Kensington and Fistral Beach, this becomes a tactical affair where positioning will be crucial. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a sustained finish, as they won't face honest fractions to test their stamina.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is steady as expected with minimal early pressure on Punchbowl Flyer
scenarios.body: The large contingent of closers get perfect positioning and the race becomes a sprint finish where the best finishers prevail. Multiple hold-up horses can unleash finishing kicks simultaneously.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Punchbowl Flyer gets an easy lead and the hold-up horses leave their runs too late
scenarios.body: The veteran gets first run on his rivals and holds on as the closers struggle to coordinate their challenges in the large field. His recent form at the trip gives him the stamina edge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If Happier tracks Punchbowl Flyer and avoids the inevitable traffic problems behind
scenarios.body: The returning prominent runner gets a perfect stalking trip and kicks clear before the hold-up brigade can get organized. His fresh legs after 168 days off prove decisive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If both Punchbowl Flyer and Happier go too slowly and multiple horses make simultaneous moves
scenarios.body: The race becomes a complete lottery as 10+ horses try to finish at once in a bunched field. The best-positioned horse on the outside or those with the strongest finishing kick benefit.

watchPoints.text: Punchbowl Flyer getting uncontested lead as large hold-up field may give him too much rope
Traffic problems in straight with 10+ hold-up horses needing room simultaneously
Happier's fitness after 168-day break and whether he can handle step up from 5-6f to 7f
Fistral Beach for any signs of bleeding issues that affected her last start
Draw advantage for Cooramook in stall 12 if race becomes cavalry charge finish

races.name: Download The Raceday Ready App Fillies' Handicap

runners_data.name: Suhub
runners_data.note: Front-runner returning after 242 days off, likely to need the run but should ensure a good gallop
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-William Haggas; still a maiden but showed a fair level of ability last year, notably when placed in novices at Leicester (7f) and Newmarket (1m), but she was well below her best in a Chelmsford AW handicap on final start (1m2f); sold 30,000gns since; acts on AW but has stamina to prove.

runners_data.name: Alkumatic Jo Jo
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer in good form, career-best effort last time and trip should suit perfectly
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden; career-best performance when 1.75l second at Haydock last time (1m, good to soft); has some good AW form as well and comes into the reckoning but the step up a trip is a concern, having been below her best in only run at beyond 1m.

runners_data.name: Semper Femina
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with limited turf form but won well at this trip on AW previously
runners_data.spotlight: Unexposed; second in a Kempton maiden in March (1m3f; 9-4; winner now rated 86) but has been beaten double-digit lengths in two turf runs since; interesting on back on AW on handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Silky Lass
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who stays well, good AW record and handles this track
runners_data.spotlight: Won a Newcastle novice in February (1m) and sound third in an 8.5f handicap here last time; shapes as though she will stay this far (well beaten on turf when tried at 1m2f); each-way chance.

runners_data.name: Romantic Spirit
runners_data.note: Proven front-runner at this course and distance with strong AW record, returning from break
runners_data.spotlight: Has won four of 12 races on the AW, three over C&D, and the latest at Southwell last October (1m3f) off this mark; should come on for her latest run in April when back from a break; can go well.

runners_data.name: Imola
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with excellent AW record, both wins this year but 104 days since last run
runners_data.spotlight: Strike-rate of 2-22 on the AW but both wins have been this year, the latest off 3lb lower over C&D in February when a well-backed favourite; has been off since so may be better for the run.

runners_data.name: Pearly Squirrel
runners_data.note: Prominent racer better over shorter trips, may struggle with this step up in distance
runners_data.spotlight: Both wins over 7f, the second here in March; good third to a subsequent winner at Newbury (1m, good) last time but not sure this step up in trip will suit as she can pull hard.

runners_data.name: Wave Rock
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer, two recent C&D wins off lower marks with Oisin Murphy retaining the ride
runners_data.spotlight: Has won two of her last four races, both over this C&D, the latest off 2lb lower last month; on a career-high mark but Oisin Murphy keeps the ride and has to be considered.

runners_data.name: La Kosmos
runners_data.note: Hold-up type making handicap debut, likely to improve stepped up in trip from 7f efforts
runners_data.spotlight: Three runs over 7f, all on AW, best effort when a running-on seventh at Kempton in January; likely to fare better up in trip on handicap debut.

runners_data.name: Phaedra
runners_data.note: Front-runner with mixed course record but solid recent Tapeta form over longer distances
runners_data.spotlight: Stable going well and she has run two sound races on Southwell Tapeta (1m/1m3f) this spring; wouldn't rule out but has run below her best in both starts here (1m4f and 8.5f).

runners_data.name: Quilt
runners_data.note: Prominent racer making debut at this trip, fair 7f form but distance a question mark
runners_data.spotlight: Fair AW form over 7f last season; well beaten third on firm ground at Bath on handicap debut (1m); first run at this sort of trip.

races.paceDynamic: Suhub, Romantic Spirit, and Phaedra will ensure a strong gallop from the start over this stamina-testing 1m1½f trip. The three confirmed front-runners should create an honest pace that will stretch the field and test stamina reserves in the final two furlongs. With limited early speed elsewhere in the field, these pace-setters are unlikely to face serious pressure until the business end. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and prominent racers with proven stamina who can finish strongly off a solid gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If the three front-runners maintain a genuine pace throughout
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will set up perfectly for hold-up horses to close late, with the pace-setters vulnerable in the final furlong. Stamina becomes the key asset as the race develops into a proper staying test.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If one or more pace-setters drops out early leaving a moderate gallop
scenarios.body: The race becomes more tactical with a slower pace favouring those who can dictate from the front. Early leaders get an easier time and can save energy for a sustained finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is strong but even throughout without dramatic collapse
scenarios.body: Horses tracking the leaders in prominent positions get the perfect trip to strike in the final two furlongs. They avoid the worst of a strong pace while positioning ideally for late challenges.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace-Setter Survives
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders go too slow and one kicks clear
scenarios.body: A tactical race allows a pace-setter to steal a march and hold on despite late challenges. The strong gallop never materializes, negating the closers' advantages.

watchPoints.text: Wave Rock has won twice at course and distance recently but faces a 3lb rise and career-high mark
Pearly Squirrel has both wins over 7f and may not appreciate this significant step up to 1m1½f
Romantic Spirit returns after 34 days off but has excellent course record with three wins over C&D
Imola has strong AW form but the 104-day break is a concern despite stable having winners recently
Strong pace likely means those drawn wide may struggle to get into contention from poor positions

races.name: Enjoy Summer Racing At Wolverhampton Racecourse Handicap

runners_data.name: Relevant Range
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who may struggle to see out the trip based on recent 9.5f effort
runners_data.spotlight: Enjoyed a successful winter on Tapeta at a lowly level and is back on a workable mark; again didn't look to quite see out 9.5f here three weeks ago; may well be dropped in from a wide stall.

runners_data.name: Hashtagnotions
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with 5lb claimer who needs a strong test round this track
runners_data.spotlight: Dual Newcastle winner who added two turf victories last autumn, all off lower marks; will want a good test over this trip round here and hasn't been at his best on grass lately.

runners_data.name: Asian Journey
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who should benefit from step back up in trip on favoured Tapeta surface
runners_data.spotlight: String of defeats at short prices this spring, remains a maiden and hasn't always looked the easiest; the return to Tapeta and step back up from 7f will help, though, and he holds claims under Tom Marquand.

runners_data.name: Terries Royale
runners_data.note: Natural leader but poor recent form and hasn't won for almost a year
runners_data.spotlight: Dual soft-ground winner for Michael Appleby in 2024 but it's been downhill since returning from almost a year off, with plenty of poor efforts at short prices to his name; said to have been unsuited by Chepstow's undulations last time; this is easier down 3lb.

runners_data.name: Beaming Light
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning to longer trip after recent sprint campaigns, 36 days off
runners_data.spotlight: Off the boil since finishing second off a 4lb higher mark over C&D in February but he's been running in sprints latterly; this is easier than he's used to and he ought to fare much better back from a short break.

runners_data.name: King Of Speed
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with strong course record, back at venue where he's won three times
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time C&D winner, latterly off 4lb higher in February; fine on Polytrack but the return here is an obvious plus off a career-low mark and he's another with claims in an open handicap.

runners_data.name: Age Of Time
runners_data.note: Front-runner with class edge but expensive to follow, 88-day absence could be positive
runners_data.spotlight: Useful in his younger days and has found his level again for Ian Williams latterly, albeit he's been expensive to follow; two wins and a close third from four runs round here and remains consistent, so enters calculations for his new yard after three months off.

runners_data.name: Book Of Life
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who can pull hard but consistent at the venue with multiple near-misses
runners_data.spotlight: Plenty of near-misses round here to go with his sole win (9.5f), and remains consistent and on a fair mark; can pull hard and may well be dropped in from stall 13, in which case he'll need some luck.

runners_data.name: Alex Belardo
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who is generally consistent but expensive to follow, 61 days since last run
runners_data.spotlight: Generally consistent round Dundalk in recent times, in various forms of headgear, but expensive to follow; trainer always to be respected with runners here but this is the furthest this one's been and he'll need to settle if his stamina is to hold.

runners_data.name: Scenario
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who paid for strong pace last time, this mark should be within range
runners_data.spotlight: Well held at a short price round Bath last time but paid for going with a strong pace; had hit traffic here previously and this mark should be within range for a yard also responsible for Terries Royale.

runners_data.name: Seconds Count
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 157-day break with history of hanging problems
runners_data.spotlight: Limited maiden for William Haggas and changed hands last autumn for 6,000gns; off for five months since hanging right (not for the first time) over 9.5f here for new yard and is now tried in headgear for the first time.

runners_data.name: Hachiman
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who is wildly inconsistent but showed better effort on turf last time
runners_data.spotlight: Wildly inconsistent for the Crisford yard and his current trainer; one of his better efforts back on turf last time but he's no certainty to build on it and his four previous efforts on Tapeta were ordinary.

runners_data.name: Luminous Warrior
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with 5lb claimer whose recent form has been disappointing since winter win
runners_data.spotlight: Related to a few useful winners, including on Tapeta; not much has gone right since a Polytrack win over 1m in the winter and better can be expected at this lower level and back up in distance, so is one to consider.

races.paceDynamic: Age Of Time and Terries Royale will contest the early lead, with both natural front-runners likely to ensure a solid gallop from the start. King Of Speed, Hashtagnotions and Alex Belardo should track the pace in prominent positions, while the majority of the field including Book Of Life, Asian Journey and Hachiman will need to be delivered late. The dual pace angle creates an honest tempo that should set up well for those with tactical speed who can position handy. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those with finishing kick from midfield positions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Favours Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Age Of Time and Terries Royale maintain a strong tempo throughout the race
scenarios.body: The honest pace will soften up the leaders and create perfect conditions for hold-up horses with finishing kick. Asian Journey, Book Of Life and Beaming Light can all benefit from the setup if delivered at the right time.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Rank Controls
scenarios.trigger: If King Of Speed or Hashtagnotions can track the pace and strike when leaders weaken
scenarios.body: The prominent racers will be perfectly positioned to exploit any faltering from the front two. King Of Speed has course form and Hashtagnotions has the tactical speed to make his move count.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Leader Lasts Home
scenarios.trigger: If Age Of Time can dictate terms and maintain his kick to the line
scenarios.body: His recent course form suggests he can handle the track demands and he has the class edge on most rivals. The 88-day break could have freshened him up for a bold front-running display.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits Backmarkers
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too fast early and the race becomes tactical
scenarios.body: The tempo could become stop-start which would suit the patient hold-up horses who need time to wind up. Luminous Warrior and Hachiman could benefit if the race falls apart tactically.

watchPoints.text: Age Of Time could get loose on the lead if Terries Royale doesn't provide enough pressure early
Book Of Life may be dropped in late from wide draw but can pull hard which could compromise tactics
King Of Speed represents strong trainer/course angle and gets significant drop in grade
Seconds Count returns from long break with amateur rider after previous hanging issues
Asian Journey moving back up in trip on preferred surface after string of short-price defeats

races.name: Race And Rest At The Holiday Inn Maiden Stakes (GBB Race) (Div I)

runners_data.name: Hozam
runners_data.spotlight: 32,000gns yearling who was re-sold for 67,000euros at the breeze-ups last May; twelfth foal; gelded half-brother to seven winners; an interesting newcomer.

runners_data.name: Al Qatem
runners_data.spotlight: By Lope De Vega; third foal of a Listed-placed 1m2f/1m4f winner (including on the AW); interesting newcomer.

runners_data.name: Mithridates
runners_data.spotlight: 80,000euros yearling; by No Nay Never; tenth foal; half-brother to four winners at up to 2m; dam Group 2 7f-1m2f winner; worth a market check on debut.

runners_data.name: Golden Buddy
runners_data.spotlight: 180,000euros breeze-up buy who is a half-brother to four winners; beaten 11l in a Southwell AW maiden on debut last month (1m; 22-1); much more needed.

runners_data.name: Hungarian
runners_data.spotlight: Finished second in a Southwell novice last July on only AW start; has since shown decent form in various company at up to 7f on turf, with both blinkers and cheekpieces tried; sets the standard but he was only third at 8-11 at Redcar last time so probably vulnerable again.

runners_data.name: Minerality
runners_data.spotlight: Well bred but he was a 15l eighth of 12 on Lingfield debut (AW; 50-1) last month so a lot of improvement is needed.

runners_data.name: Ramli
runners_data.spotlight: Shadwell castoff by Frankel; finished third in a Huntingdon bumper (2m, good); two fair runs on the Flat since, the first when fifth of eight at Southwell (1m4f); drop in trip not sure to suit and looks one for handicaps.

runners_data.name: Rajiba
runners_data.spotlight: 70,000gns yearling by St Mark's Basilica; ran green when 2.75l fourth of eight over 6f here last November; that form fair and should improve now up in trip; each-way chance.

runners_data.name: Kaiko
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten 20l on last month's Bath debut (1m, firm; 100-1) and needs to make marked improvement.

runners_data.name: Venetian Lion
runners_data.spotlight: Fair 4.5l seventh of nine on Yarmouth debut (1m) but well beaten ninth of ten at Redcar last week (1m, good to firm); needs much more on AW debut.

runners_data.name: Rua Mor
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-Irish; has shown fair form over hurdles; well beaten over C&D on stable debut last month; likely to fare better when going handicapping.

races.name: Race And Rest At The Holiday Inn Maiden Stakes (GBB Race) (Div II)

runners_data.name: King Of Earth
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with strongest form credentials, 44 days off might need this run
runners_data.spotlight: Has shown clear promise with second-place finishes at Newbury (1m, soft) last October and Doncaster (7f, good to soft) in March (winner has won again since); beaten 2l in a decent Newbury maiden (1m, good) since and this looks a good opportunity on AW debut.

runners_data.name: Raggaas
runners_data.note: Debutant with strong pedigree but completely unknown quantity on racecourse
runners_data.spotlight: 200,000gns yearling; seventh foal, by St Mark's Basilica; gelded half-brother to winners Rock'n Swing (French Group-placed 7.5f 2yo/1m; RPR 102), Richmond Avenue (French Listed-placed 7f; 101) and Nova Roma (1m2f; 88); dam Group-placed 7f AW 2yo winner (98), half-sister to Dubai Millennium; sports tongue-tie on debut; betting will be best guide to his chance.

runners_data.name: Retro Rocket
runners_data.note: Another debutant, much cheaper purchase suggests lower expectations
runners_data.spotlight: £1,800 yearling; second foal; by Rich History; dam once-raced half-sister to winners Hogmanay (4.5f/7f including 2yo/US) and Clock Tower (Italian 1m), out of 7f Group 3 winner; likely to be better for this debut run.

runners_data.name: Seven Sisters
runners_data.note: Showed clear promise at Salisbury, 29 days gap ideal for improvement
runners_data.spotlight: Took a while to find her feet but shaped with considerable promise when runner-up in a Salisbury maiden (7f, good to firm) last month; should have come on a bundle and be suited by the step up in trip on this AW debut.

runners_data.name: Malika
runners_data.note: Only confirmed pace angle, Murphy booking suggests stable confidence
runners_data.spotlight: Has shown only modest form so far but may well be capable of better; no surprise if she takes a sizeable step forward here.

runners_data.name: Marquessofanglesey
runners_data.note: Improved last time at Southwell, trip increase should help
runners_data.spotlight: Improved on his debut when third of nine at Southwell (7f, AW) in April; should be suited by this step back up in trip and holds place claims.

runners_data.name: Be Hopeful
runners_data.note: Poor debut form, drops back in trip which may not suit
runners_data.spotlight: Beat only one rival on debut at Lingfield (1m2f, AW; 18-1) in April; drops back in trip and should come on for the run but may need more time.

runners_data.name: Fiefdom
runners_data.note: Badly beaten debut just 13 days ago, likely needs more time
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten over 16l on his debut at Lingfield (7f, AW; 16-1) 13 days ago; needs to have come on a ton but may show more once he has qualified for handicaps.

runners_data.name: Halimede
runners_data.note: Fading tendency noted, poor debut suggests not ready yet
runners_data.spotlight: Always behind when ninth of 11 on debut at Southwell (1m, AW; 80-1) 11 days ago; not one for today but of more interest when she qualifies for handicaps.

runners_data.name: Cy Twombly
runners_data.note: Long absence since gelding, new trainer has poor strike rate
runners_data.spotlight: Made the frame twice for the Crisfords in October/November 2024; gelded subsequently and changed hands for 4,800gns in March 2025; has not returned in the same form after 13 months off, including when last of 11 on handicap debut at Southwell (1m, AW; 50-1) in January, following wind surgery; cheekpieces added.

runners_data.name: Vino Sauro
runners_data.note: Fading tendency and 136 days off major concerns, poor current form
runners_data.spotlight: Encouraging third on his debut for Richard Fahey in April 2025; fair third for current trainer in Meydan last November but well held on three subsequent runs there; hard to fancy on his return to Britain.

races.paceDynamic: Malika will take the field along as the only confirmed front runner, likely setting a comfortable pace without pressure. King Of Earth, Seven Sisters, Marquessofanglesey and the other hold-up types will settle behind in a bunched field over this 1m2f trip. The sustainable gallop will allow the field to stay compact until the straight, where stamina and class will separate them. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with proven class, as the lack of pace pressure will neutralise pure speed horses and reward those who can quicken from handy positions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Classy Types Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate and King Of Earth or Seven Sisters get good runs
scenarios.body: The even gallop allows the higher-rated horses with proven form to use their class advantage in the final furlong. King Of Earth's Newbury second and Seven Sisters' Salisbury runner-up effort represent the strongest form lines in this field.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Malika Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Malika gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear turning in
scenarios.body: Her prominent style perfectly suits the lack of early pace, and she can dictate terms before the hold-up horses get organised. The Andrew Balding/Oisin Murphy combination adds confidence to her chances of improvement.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Debutant Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Raggaas or Retro Rocket show significant improvement from their breeding
scenarios.body: The moderate pace gives inexperienced horses time to settle and learn, while their pedigrees suggest they could possess untapped ability. Raggaas particularly appeals as a 200,000gns yearling with Group-placed siblings.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Veteran Revival
scenarios.trigger: If Cy Twombly or Vino Sauro benefit from recent stable changes and the longer trip
scenarios.body: The steady gallop might suit older horses finding their form again, especially with Cy Twombly's gelding operation and stable switch. However, their recent poor form makes this unlikely.

watchPoints.text: Raggaas market moves given his pedigree suggests significant stable confidence despite being a complete unknown
Malika's early positioning as she needs to use her pace advantage without going too hard early
King Of Earth's jumping from the gates after 44-day break to secure good position for his hold-up style
Seven Sisters and Marquessofanglesey getting clear runs in straight as both need room to show their best
Cy Twombly's attitude and enthusiasm after stable switch and gelding operation

races.name: Free Digital Racecard At raceday-ready.com Classified Stakes

runners_data.name: Colors Of Freedom
runners_data.note: Prominent racer well-drawn in stall 2 but poor recent record with only one win in last 29 starts raises reliability concerns
runners_data.spotlight: Three-time C&D winner who's well drawn for one happiest up front; only won one of her last 29 starts, which include 18 defeats at 6-1 or shorter, and she has a bit more on coming out of handicap company, but she usually gives her running round here.

runners_data.name: Nad Alshiba Snow
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare switching to third stable with moderate form, Robert Havlin booking provides some hope but regressive profile worrying
runners_data.spotlight: Regressive maiden who's with her third yard; threatened to pick up a small handicap in the winter but had plenty of chances and has a bit more on her plate coming out of handicap company.

runners_data.name: He's An Angel
runners_data.note: Hold-up type prone to slow starts and pulling hard, distance drop to 5f may not suit after recent 6f campaigns
runners_data.spotlight: Not as good since missing more than a year, does most racing over 6f and will always come with risks, given a propensity to blow the start and/or pull hard; this is easier down to 0-50 company for the first time, though, and he's capable if it falls right.

runners_data.name: Lion Ring
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner who won twice here earlier in the year, will appreciate return to AW surface after disappointing on turf 16 days ago
runners_data.spotlight: Dual course winner early in the year for 5lb claimer Ryan Kavanagh, and will be happier back on the AW and down from 7f; would have been better off with all bar one were this a handicap, however.

runners_data.name: Blue Jay Way
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse resuming in decent form but only raced over 5f once when well held at this course two years ago
runners_data.spotlight: Only run over 5f once, when well held over C&D two years ago, and has done most recent racing over 7f; resumed in decent form and this is easier if anything but the drop back in trip from the outside stall would have to be a worry; headgear returns.

runners_data.name: Bust A Moon
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 251 days off, won seller last May and new stable could revive his fortunes
runners_data.spotlight: Won a Beverley seller last May but then struggled for two yards; this easier for another new stable and he ran well first time out last season, which gives hope after eight months off.

runners_data.name: Charging Bull
runners_data.note: Free-going prominent type who ran well here in April from similar draw, 7lb claimer Kyle McHugh takes pressure off
runners_data.spotlight: Free-going maiden who bumped into one when making a lot of the running from a similar draw over C&D in April; gone both ways under pressure before but this is his first crack at 0-50 company and he's one to consider.

runners_data.name: A Lott Of Kane
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse carrying 7lb penalty for recent 6f win here, tendency to pull hard from wide draw creates tactical concerns
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced compared to most of these and holds obvious claims on his last-time 6f win here in March; always the concern that he'll pull hard again, from a wide stall, after two months off, but he's been found the right race.

runners_data.name: Yesnia
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare prone to fading in finish, headgear changes suggest connections seeking improvement after moderate Irish form
runners_data.spotlight: Three ordinary efforts round Dundalk at huge prices last backend; offered more for her new yard, minus the hood and in a tongue-tie, when not best drawn as it turned out on her turf/handicap debut, in April; could have improvement in her.

runners_data.name: She Went Whoosh
runners_data.note: Hold-up type wearing tongue-tie and hood, latest second over 6f at Lingfield suggests return to form for Scott Dixon
runners_data.spotlight: Only gone whoosh once, when winning a Polytrack handicap for Richard Hannon last spring; regressed since, often from the front, but holds claims on her latest turf second to a subsequent winner.

runners_data.name: She's A Gift
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare making Tapeta debut after disappointing Irish form, fade-in-finish warning makes her hard to trust over minimum trip
runners_data.spotlight: Poor Irish maiden who's still to finish placed after 15 starts; trainer's record here down the years (11-41) entitles her to some respect on her Tapeta debut at this lower level though; interesting to see how she goes in the market.

races.paceDynamic: Lion Ring will dictate from the front with Colors Of Freedom and Charging Bull likely to press early, creating a contested but manageable pace over this minimum trip. The prominent runners will set a solid gallop without burning each other out, while the hold-up horses like A Lott Of Kane, Blue Jay Way and She Went Whoosh face the challenge of making up ground in a sprint finish. With multiple front-runners ensuring no slow pace and the short distance limiting closing kicks, this race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those with early pace who can sit close to the speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Suits Prominent
scenarios.trigger: If Lion Ring and Colors Of Freedom maintain honest fractions without going too fast early
scenarios.body: The pace will be solid enough to string out the field but sustainable enough for those tracking the leaders to strike in the final furlong. Prominent racers with tactical speed will have the perfect setup to pounce when the leaders tire.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Lion Ring gets an uncontested lead and dictates soft fractions
scenarios.body: The 8-year-old can use his proven front-running ability to control the race from the front, with the hold-up horses unable to make up the deficit over 5f. His recent course wins show he knows how to win when allowed to dominate.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too strong between Lion Ring, Colors Of Freedom and Charging Bull
scenarios.body: The speed horses will go too fast and set it up for a closer with a turn of foot in the final two furlongs. A Lott Of Kane's recent 6f win here shows he has the acceleration when not pulling hard.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If Lion Ring fails to lead cleanly or Colors Of Freedom doesn't break well from the wide draw
scenarios.body: The race lacks early pace and becomes a messy sprint where any horse with a late kick can pick up the pieces. This tactical muddle could suit an improver or horse returning from a break.

watchPoints.text: Lion Ring must break cleanly from stall 6 to establish his preferred front-running position before Colors Of Freedom or Charging Bull can challenge
A Lott Of Kane could pull hard again from the wide draw in stall 10, which would compromise his chances of settling for a late run
Colors Of Freedom needs to overcome her poor recent strike rate and justify market confidence despite being well-positioned in the draw
Blue Jay Way dropping back to 5f for only the second time in his career represents a significant distance question
Charging Bull's 7lb claiming allowance with Kyle McHugh could prove decisive if the pace sets up right for his prominent style

races.name: Get The Inside Track With raceday-ready.com Handicap

runners_data.name: Giorgio M
runners_data.note: Natural front runner likely to dictate terms but three wins over 7f suggest stamina questions at this minimum trip
runners_data.spotlight: Three wins, and most racing, come over 7f, including when making all on his second start for this yard on Polytrack off 6lb higher in the winter; not at his best lately and, while well drawn, may not get his own way as he likes back down in trip.

runners_data.name: Beyond Borders
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse from poor draw in stall 13 who struggles outside small fields and needs everything to fall right
runners_data.spotlight: Currently 2-3 on Tapeta but he's generally struggled since leaving Karl Burke, his only win coming when allowed his own way in a small field last summer (been dropped in lately); the first-time tongue-tie will need to make a difference.

runners_data.name: Lesley's Boy
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning from 46-day break after poor turf comeback, better on artificial surfaces
runners_data.spotlight: Decent 2yo who struggled last year, coming more than a stone down the weights; found his level again latterly on Tapeta but he ran poorly on his turf comeback in April and others make more obvious appeal.

runners_data.name: Fuji Mountain
runners_data.note: Prominent racer making AW debut with blinkers removed, inconsistent but capable off career-low mark
runners_data.spotlight: Decent 2yo who proved hard to place last year and has again lacked consistency this spring; the blinkers come off as he makes his AW debut off a career-low mark and it's hard to know what to expect in truth.

runners_data.name: Daytona Lady
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare from awkward stall 12 who often misses break but has strong C&D record including recent win
runners_data.spotlight: Can miss the break and is often ridden from off the pace (every chance she will be again from stall 12); notched a third C&D win when taking a small-field affair against her own sex off 2lb lower in April; slight drop-off latest and has to bounce back.

runners_data.name: Havana Sky
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 90-day break with Oisin Murphy booking suggesting stable confidence despite long absence
runners_data.spotlight: All eight wins come over this trip, including three over C&D, but never off a mark quite this high; nothing to suggest he's best caught fresh but the booking of Oisin Murphy is an obvious plus after three months off.

runners_data.name: Initial Blue
runners_data.note: Prominent racer in good form with blinkers on, proven front runner but doesn't have to lead
runners_data.spotlight: Enjoying a consistent year, winning twice from the front at Kempton since the blinkers went on (doesn't have to lead); nothing wrong with his clear second at Southwell a month ago and holds decent claims despite a further 2lb rise.

runners_data.name: Iconic Times
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse struggling since yard change, better over further than this minimum trip
runners_data.spotlight: Wins for Heather Main came at Kempton; not at his best for this yard, including back to sprinting last time after a spell over further, and isn't obviously fancied from the outside stall.

runners_data.name: Winchurch
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who won easily from front last time, drawn well to attack early if connections choose aggressive tactics
runners_data.spotlight: Took advantage of a sliding mark when easily winning an ordinary Nottingham handicap from the front five weeks ago; drawn to attack again and fine on Tapeta but an 8lb rise will test him into a deeper race.

runners_data.name: Wodao
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 133-day break, Listed winner as juvenile but regressed significantly since
runners_data.spotlight: Listed winner in Ireland as a 2yo who regressed sharply for Jamie Osborne; been off for four four months since well held over C&D and the change of scenery will need to have done the trick.

runners_data.name: Watermelon Sugar
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who excels at Lingfield but off the boil recently, this represents tougher assignment
runners_data.spotlight: Took advantage of a sliding mark round Lingfield in the winter (last four wins come there but is fine on Tapeta); off the boil since and this is a bit tougher; would want to see some support tonight.

runners_data.name: Teardrops
runners_data.note: Hold-up type changing hands recently with claim, three Newcastle wins over winter but 5lb higher now
runners_data.spotlight: Three Newcastle wins for Richard Spencer over the winter, latterly off 5lb lower, and remained competitive before changing hands for 5,000gns; usual tongue-tie/blinkers absent for his new yard latest (same again here), when well below par on turf.

races.paceDynamic: Giorgio M represents the only confirmed front runner in this field, likely to set a sustainable pace without early pressure. Initial Blue and Fuji Mountain may track prominently early but both can settle if needed. The majority of this field are hold-up horses including Daytona Lady, Havana Sky, Beyond Borders, and Watermelon Sugar, suggesting they'll be content to let Giorgio M dictate terms. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners and those with tactical speed to position close to the pace, as the weight of hold-up horses will create traffic problems in the straight.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Giorgio M gets an easy lead and isn't pressured through the early fractions
scenarios.body: The pace will be too slow for the hold-up brigade to make significant inroads, allowing those who can travel close to the pace to dominate. Front runners and prominent racers will have every advantage in a slowly-run sprint.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If Initial Blue or Winchurch challenge Giorgio M for the early lead creating genuine pace
scenarios.body: The increased gallop will suit those with a finishing kick but they'll need to be positioned handily to benefit. Strong travellers who can sit prominent will get first run on the field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and the field bunches entering the straight
scenarios.body: Superior class and finishing speed will prevail despite the tactical disadvantage of racing from behind. This requires a truly pedestrian early gallop that never picks up.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the pace scenario creates chaos with interference or very slow fractions benefiting an unconsidered runner
scenarios.body: A horse at longer odds gets the perfect setup through either tactical positioning or avoiding trouble. Market leaders get compromised by poor pace or positioning.

watchPoints.text: Giorgio M could get uncontested lead and prove impossible to peg back if pace becomes pedestrian
Daytona Lady often misses break badly from stall 12 which would compromise her chances significantly
Havana Sky returning from 90-day break but Oisin Murphy booking suggests stable expects big run fresh
Initial Blue has tactical speed to press Giorgio M early if connections want to ensure strong pace
Winchurch won last time leading throughout and drawn perfectly in stall 4 to repeat front-running tactics
